Fore School of Management }} '''Sminu Jindal''' (born 18 January 1973) is an Indian industrialist. She is the managing director of Jindal SAW Limited{{Cite web|url=https://www.jindalsaw.com/|title=JINDAL SAW LTD.|website=www.jindalsaw.com}} and Founder-Chairperson of Svayam,{{Cite web|url=http://www.svayam.com/|title=Welcome to svayam.com|website=www.svayam.com}} an initiative of the Sminu Jindal Trust & India's leading accessibility rights organization. She currently also serves as the Chairperson of the CII India Business and Disability Network (CII IBDN). She married Mr. Indresh Batra in 2001, and they have two sons, Anav Batra and Arjan Batra. She belongs to the US$22 billion O.P. Jindal Group.{{Cite web|url=https://www.jindalsaw.com/jindal-organization.php|title=JINDAL SAW LTD.|website=www.jindalsaw.com}} Jindal was appointed as the managing director of Jindal SAW Ltd. in February 2001. She also held the position of managing director of Hexa Tradex Ltd. from October 2011 to August 2016. She has been Chairperson of the [[ASSOCHAM|Assocham]] National Council on Iron & Steel{{Cite web|url=https://www.assocham.org/nationalcouncil.php|title=Assocham India :: National Councils|website=www.assocham.org}} since 2007. ==Early life== Sminu studied at prestigious [[Maharani Gayatri Devi Girls' Public School]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.mgdschooljaipur.com/|title=MGD School, Jaipur|website=www.mgdschooljaipur.com}} in [[Jaipur, Rajasthan]] and Presentation Convent Senior Secondary School{{Cite web|url=http://www.pcsdelhi.in/|title=Presentation Convent School|website=www.pcsdelhi.in}} in [[New Delhi]] before graduating in commerce from [[Shri Ram College of Commerce]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.srcc.edu/|title=Shri Ram College of Commerce|website=www.srcc.edu}} (SRCC), [[New Delhi]]. At the age of 11, she was involved in an accident while traveling from Jaipur to New Delhi, which resulted in her needing a wheelchair for the rest of her life.{{Cite news|url=http://inspireminds.in/englishblog/895/success-story-of-sminu-jindal-md-jindal-saw-ltd.html|title=Success Story of Sminu Jindal, MD, Jindal Saw Ltd.|newspaper=inspireminds.in|access-date=2011-12-24}} ==Business== Jindal joined Jindal SAW Limited as a management trainee (1 August 1992 to 30 June 1994) in one of its loss-making factories when she was 19. She was then promoted to Executive-Corporate Planning (1 July 1994 to 31 March 1995). Jindal helped the company venture into new business areas including urban development, domestic transport, and logistics under the company's subsidiary Jindal ITF (JITF) Urban Infrastructure.{{Cite web|url=http://jindalitf.com/|title=Jindal ITF | Nurturing the Future}} ==Launch of the initiative "Svayam" by SJCT== In October 2000, SJCT launched its initiative 'Svayam' as a web-portal.{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-miscellaneous/tp-others/a-website-for-disabled/article28046660.ece|title=A website for disabled|first=Our Staff|last=Reporter|newspaper=The Hindu
